title: The Missing Star Chart
scene: Between 8:40 and 9:00 PM, the brass star chart vanished from the dome. The library door sensor records every visit.

suspects.name: Nora Penn
suspects.testimony: I logged meteor counts in the library from 8:35 to 9:05 PM, completely alone the whole time.
suspects.alibiProof: The library entry sensor recorded only Nora inside from 8:35 to 9:05 PM.

suspects.name: Ezra Bell
suspects.testimony: I was in the library with Nora from 8:35 to 9:05 PM, helping her organize the meteor logs.
suspects.contradiction: The library sensor shows only Nora entered, and the rolled star chart was hidden in Ezra's satchel.

suspects.name: Ruby Fox
suspects.testimony: I tidied pamphlets at the desk outside the library glass from 8:35 to 9:05 PM; only Nora was inside.
suspects.alibiProof: A visiting family chatted with Ruby at the lobby desk from 8:35 to 9:05 PM.

suspects.name: Dean Cruz
suspects.testimony: I oiled the dome hinges just outside the star chart case from 8:40 to 9:00 PM.
suspects.alibiProof: The security camera outside the dome shows Dean oiling the hinges from 8:40 to 9:00 PM.
